annotations.text: Structure: left rail (Flows, Runs, Bindings, Agents and tools, API, Data, Settings), centre workspace, right inspector. The eleven tabs are gone; every old screen has a home. Command palette on ⌘K lists the same actions the TUI, SDK and CLI have.
All content is real: the fixtures project, the comp run that compensated, the fake-gateway record decision, the WebMCP binding, the heal of schedule-build-link, the agent invocations from the audit.

yam ui: full authoring cockpit, standalone Ink app over the same service. Four numbered panes, Tab to cycle, ^K palette with the same action list as the app. --json streams the audit pane for agents. Shown: run comp after compensation, palette open on 'heal'.
Dark-first, light theme beside it. Radix primitives, own tokens. One accent (amber), five status colours with words beside them. Every control named and id'd for the desktop adapters.
